model.carrier: four-waveguide chiral star with one bright central guide and a two-dimensional dark outer subspace
model.scope: coupled-mode preflight; not full-wave electromagnetic simulation and not a fabrication certificate

baselineConfig.outerPath: n(z)=(sqrt(7)/4 cos(2pi z/L), sqrt(7)/4 sin(2pi z/L), 3/4)

fabricationPathGate.reason: The exact constant-latitude quarter-turn schedule crosses negative components of kappa, whereas ordinary passive gap-controlled evanescent couplings are nonnegative. The published SO(2) work treats theta=pi/2 as a limiting or separate braiding construction rather than a generic finite fixed-coupling loop.
reopenRoutes: supply independently calibrated pi phase sections or auxiliary paths that realize signed effective couplings
cascade two separately returned SO(2) modules whose calibrated angles sum to pi/2
replace the exact latitude by a full-wave-verified positive-octant/braiding path and recompute the robustness budget

twoModuleAlternative.target: two independently calibrated pi/4 holonomy modules with reversed copies
twoModuleAlternative.publishedStatus: architecture-supported but not reported as the complete AZ-027 tuple
twoModuleAlternative.caution: Published matrix fidelity and approximately 95% dark power do not identify delta/kappa0 or differential gamma/kappa0 and therefore do not certify the analytic budget.

selectorCompatibility.reason: A passive anisotropic selector strong enough to contract a dark-state projective coordinate is itself differential loss or splitting; leaving it active during the holonomy stage spends the same nu/delta budget used to certify geometry.
selectorCompatibility.admissibleArchitecture: calibrate Y independently; switch or spatially separate it from the holonomy loop; perform measurement-conditioned reinjection or a separately modelled dissipative cascade; report Y-off and Y-on records independently
selectorCompatibility.forbiddenShortcut: do not interpret unreported passive filtering inside the holonomy guide as independent two-datum selection

coupledModePassRequires: reversal flips the reference-anchored oriented amplitude
dark-subspace retention and full complex transfer are reported
physicalPassRequires: complex 2x2 process tomography against an external phase reference
